name: ToastRootPrimitive
description: A single toast, colored by the `colorPalette` of its toast object. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: toast
props.description: Toast to show, usually one item of `useToastManager().toasts`. Its `colorPalette`, `icon`, `close`, and `actionProps` set the color, icon, close button, and action button of the toast.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: swipeDirection
props.description: Direction(s) in which the toast can be swiped to dismiss.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Toast.RootPrimitive.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
